scope: Source-reviewed, non-game API/runtime compatibility candidates not previously represented by an exact project URL or ID. This batch stages the distinct Wine Mono .NET Framework runtime; it is separate from the cataloged general Mono runtime and does not claim to be a Windows system-API translation layer.

projects.title: Wine Mono (.NET Framework Runtime for Wine)
projects.game: Windows .NET Framework applications and games (multi-application runtime)
projects.platform: Microsoft .NET Framework applications targeting 4.8.1 and earlier → Wine on Linux, macOS, BSD, and other Wine-supported hosts
projects.status: WineHQ's latest release directed to Wine users is wine-mono-11.3.0 (2026-08-17). wine-mono-11.2.1 (2026-09-04) is a bug-fix release for Proton; its release notes direct Wine users to 11.3.0. The canonical repository's latest commit was 2026-10-14 and only changed contributor-policy documentation. Compatibility depends on each application and the implemented .NET Framework behavior.
projects.summary: Wine Mono packages a modified Framework Mono runtime, class libraries, and related components as an implementation of .NET Framework 4.8.1 and earlier for applications running inside Wine. It works with Wine's built-in mscoree.dll and is explicitly not intended as a general-purpose Mono distribution. This is a managed-framework runtime reimplementation, separate from Wine's Windows system-API compatibility layer and from the general, legacy mono/mono runtime; it does not guarantee that every .NET application will work.
projects.strategy: A modified Mono runtime and class-library package is installed into Wine and integrated with Wine's built-in mscoree.dll to implement .NET Framework behavior for Windows managed applications.
projects.source_available: Public source in the WineHQ GitLab repository. The COPYING file describes multiple component licenses, including GPL/LGPL/MIT for Mono portions, LGPL for the compiler, and distinct terms for bundled components; GitHub reports NOASSERTION, so no single repository-wide SPDX license is claimed.
